name: Pound Puppies
description: Lucky, Cookie and the rest of the dogs in Shelter 17 have an important secret mission: to help every dog that comes to the pound find a new home.

videos.title: The Yipper Caper
videos.overview: When an unmatchable pup meets and loses the boy of his dreams, the pound puppies do what they do best.

videos.title: Nightmare on Pound Street
videos.overview: While Mcleish takes care of his niece and nephew, the puppies try to place a sweet but scary dog.

videos.title: Rebound
videos.overview: The Puppies try to find a home for Rebound, the most energetic puppy they have ever seen.

videos.title: The General
videos.overview: Lucky and the gang are given a daunting task to complete.

videos.title: The Prince and the Pupper
videos.overview: Squirt switches places with an aristocratic dog.

videos.title: Catcalls
videos.overview: The puppies and kitties try to get placed in a new home.

videos.title: King of the Heap
videos.overview: Niblet is taken to a new junkyard.

videos.title: My Fair Rebound
videos.overview: Agatha McLeish tries to prove that her dog is top dog when she enters Rebound in a dog show.

videos.title: Quintuplets
videos.overview: Finding a home for five puppies determined to stick together.

videos.title: Dog on a Wire
videos.overview: Strudel realizes her dream of being a performance dog when they return a circus dog to the big top.

videos.title: Homeward Pound
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies try to find Squirt and Niblet.

videos.title: Rebel Without a Collar
videos.overview: A trio of Marx brothers-esque dogs called the Three Wise Guys arrive at the Pound in search of the Star Pup, a dog destined to defeat Captain Slaughter. The Star Pup is easily identified by a star-shaped birthmark. But when Nose Marie is suddenly idenified as the Star Pup by the mark on her neck, she is celebrated. But does she have the knowhow to beat the captain?

videos.title: Taboo
videos.overview: Someone or something has been stealing the puppies' items: Cooler's blanket, Nose Marie's necklace, Bright Eyes' doll and Whopper's squeak toy...

videos.title: Toyoshiko! Bark Friend Machine
videos.overview: When the Terrible Terrier haunts Holly's Puppy Pound, the Pound Puppies turn to Biff Barker, a famous dog actor from a well-known TV series, "Ghost Hounders", for help.

videos.title: Zoltron
videos.overview: Zoltron gets separated from his family during an outing.

videos.title: The Really Weird Dog
videos.overview: Rover seeks the help of Lucky and his gang to help find his person.

videos.title: Bone Voyage
videos.overview: Rebound is left at the pound when Agatha decides that it's time for a vacation.

videos.title: Snow Problem
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies become sled dogs to help a friend.

videos.title: The K9 Kid
videos.overview: Pepper is determined to become a K9 dog even though he's not the right size or breed.

videos.title: The Call of the Squirrel Dog
videos.overview: How Mr. Nut Nut became a part of the Pound Puppies team.

videos.title: I Never Barked for My Father
videos.overview: Lucky is forced to deal with his past when Niblet brings some new dogs to the Shelter to hide from the dogcatcher.

videos.title: McLeish Unleashed
videos.overview: McLeish gets promoted and his replacement means business and makes it hard to place pups.

videos.title: Olaf in Love
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies try to get Olaf and Gertrude to fall in love so they can make a loving home for a new pup.

videos.title: Kennel Kittens Return
videos.overview: Squirt goes undercover as a cat to steal Strudel's invention back from the Kennel Kittens who stole it.

videos.title: Mutternal Instincts
videos.overview: To the gangs surprise, Cookie has been preventing a pup from getting adopted.

videos.title: Lucky Gets Adopted
videos.overview: A lonesome little girl adopts Lucky and he'll do anything to get back to the Shelter.

videos.title: Zipper the Zoomit Dog
videos.overview: Squirt reveals his secret past and vows to train Zipper to catch flying discs.

videos.title: The Fraud Princess
videos.overview: Agatha's new beau brings a nosey playmate over for Rebound.

videos.title: The Super Secret Pup Club
videos.overview: Rebound and Cupcake join Patches to create their own puppy placing troupe.

videos.title: Barlow
videos.overview: Barlow encourages his fellow canines to adopt a lackadaisical philosophy; Lucy races to find Barlow's person before the Pound Puppies fail their next mission.

videos.title: There's Something About Camelia
videos.overview: When Camelia arrives at Shelter 17, Lucky and his team are challenged to find her a real match.

videos.title: Good Dog McLeish
videos.overview: McLeish believes he is hypnotized; He joins the Pound Puppies on their mission to match Piper to her person.

videos.title: The Ruff Ruff Bunch
videos.overview: The Super Secret Pup Club is initiated into a fancy dog club.

videos.title: Salty
videos.overview: The Club meets an old, injured sea dog looking for a replacement pup.

videos.title: Squawk
videos.overview: Niblet spills secrets to a parrot who begins to tell the humans.

videos.title: The Accidental Pup Star
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies spring into action to stop McLeish from getting famous.

videos.title: No Dogs Allowed
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies investigate why people are returning their pups and find that the landlord has a no-dogs-allowed policy.

videos.title: Pound Preemies
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies and the Super Secret Pup Club must ensure the delivery of the preemie pups to the right homes.

videos.title: I Heard the Barks on Christmas Eve
videos.overview: When the Pound Puppies need a miracle to place hundreds of puppies in homes, Rebound's tenacity may be just the Christmas miracle.

videos.title: Working K-9 to 5
videos.overview: Dolores must prove to her father that she is responsible enough to have a puppy; Dolores becomes a delivery girl for the newspaper.

videos.title: Cuddle Up Buttercup
videos.overview: Buttercup looks like the latest toy sensation that children think she is a toy that comes to life; Pound Puppies try to find her a perfect person before she gets taken.

videos.title: The Pups Who Loved Me
videos.overview: The Super Secret Pup Club sets off agent Bondo's flying car and travels to London.

videos.title: Fright at the Museum
videos.overview: The puppies sneak into a museum to place a pup with the curator's granddaughter; Niblet and Squirt face a cat mummy.

videos.title: Puddles the Problem Pup
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies are all ready to place Puddles with his perfect person Sam, but there's one problem... Puddles isn't housebroken! They work together to find creative ways to train Puddles until they realize that Sam may have the solution.

videos.title: It's Elementary My Dear Pup Club
videos.overview: When a boy gets in trouble in school, Pepper and the club investigate to clear his name.

videos.title: Hot Dawg
videos.overview: Pupster's chance to find his perfect person may be ruined when a love triangle between Cookie, Strudel and a new smooth-talking Chihuahua named Antonio threatens to break up the team.

videos.title: I'm Ready for my Close Pup
videos.overview: Cupcake becomes star-struck while filling in for Pooches, the TV sitcom pup.

videos.title: When Niblet Met Giblet
videos.overview: Giblet and Niblet fall in love at first sight. When Giblet is adopted, Niblet sets out to find her.

videos.title: Once a Ralph, Always a Ralph
videos.overview: The puppies suspect that Ralph is ruining their plans on purpose, so Lucky tests his loyalty.

videos.title: Hello Kitten
videos.overview: The Super Secret Pup Club take an adoption mission.

videos.title: Beauty is Only Fur Deep
videos.overview: A heroic rescue dog arrives at the shelter without any fur; Squirt makes him a full-body toupee, but the pup's lack of confidence makes it difficult to find him the perfect home.

videos.title: The Watchdogs
videos.overview: Strudel begins leading a double life after being mistaken for a superhero, but her new job threatens her position on the team.

videos.title: Hail to the Chief
videos.overview: Strudel is challenged with finding the perfect people for energetic pup.

videos.title: All Bark and Little Bite
videos.overview: Two of Patches' old friends tease him for hanging out with girl pups.

videos.title: Lucky the Dunce
videos.overview: When an accident makes Lucky go goofy, Niblet must decide whether or not to give him up for the good of the pups.

videos.title: Back in Action
videos.overview: Nothing can bring Bert, the former star of the TV show McBowser, out of his grumpy funk until Jackpot and his person Emily find themselves stuck in a runaway electric wheelchair. It's McBowser to the rescue in a wild chase through the city.

videos.title: The Truth Is in Hear
videos.overview: McLeish finds Strudel's super-hearing electronic Hearmuffs and starts hearing strange things that lead him to believe the dogs are aliens.

videos.title: No More S'mores
videos.overview: Shy pup Millard accidentally ends up on a camping trip with the High Energy Scouts and the Pound Puppies race to place him with his perfect person before the scouts overwhelm him for good!

videos.title: Doubles Trouble
videos.overview: Sibling squabbles between Sweet Pea and Hairy threaten their adoption and their perfect owners' ping pong championship.

videos.title: Little Monster
videos.overview: Noodles feels left out when his humans bring home a baby named J.D., and comes up with a crazy plan to get rid of him.

videos.title: Rebound's First Symphony
videos.overview: After a dispute between Agatha and Sumalee's mother makes it nearly impossible for YoYo to be matched with Sumalee, beautiful music brings peace to the neighborhood when they finally get together.

videos.title: Lord of the Fleas
videos.overview: During an island adventure, Solo, an adventurous pup, wanders off into the jungle and it's up to the Pound Puppies to save him before a volcano erupts.

videos.title: The Road to Empawerment
videos.overview: Niblet leads three unique pups on a dangerous journey of self-discovery after listening to a motivational speaker.

videos.title: The Pupple's Court
videos.overview: Pound Puppy Agent Miss Stiffwhiskers brings Lucky before a Pound Puppy tribunal for breaking Pound Puppy rules. A guilty verdict means the end of Shelter 17!

videos.title: Lucky Has to Move
videos.overview: The Pound Puppies try to prevent Lucky from moving away by jinxing a promotion for Dot's dad.
